Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Mathematics BA at University of Oxford

What University of Oxford asks of applicants to Mathematics BA for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Oxford courses · Mathematics field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with USA qualifications: three APs at grade 5 (including AP Calculus BC) plus ACT 33+ or SAT 1480+ — or four APs at grade 5 (including AP Calculus BC) with no SAT/ACT
  • Optional ACT/SAT essay not required

The department page heads this “American qualifications”/“USA qualifications”; it does not say “US high-school diploma” in those words.

Verified19 Oct 2026Oxford Mathematical Institute: Our Offer
English language
  • Higher level English language requirement (all Oxford courses)
  • IELTS (Academic recommended; IELTS Online not accepted): 7.5 overall, minimum 7.0 per component
  • TOEFL iBT: 110 overall (Listening 22, Reading 24, Speaking 25, Writing 24) — only tests taken up to and including 20 January 2026 are accepted
  • PTE Academic: 76 overall, minimum 66 in Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing
  • C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency:
    • 191 overall, minimum 185 per component
    • Oxford Test of English (Advanced): 165, minimum 155 per component
  • All component scores from a single test session (no superscoring)
  • Not needed if English is your first language and you have always been a resident and citizen of a majority English-speaking country recognised by UKVI

Evidence is not needed at application; offer holders must meet the requirement by 31 July of the year of the offer. TOEFL tests taken from 21 January 2026 are not accepted while the new format is under review. Other accepted qualifications (e.g. Trinity ISE, GCSE/IGCSE English, IB English B at HL 7) and exemptions (e.g. an English-taught IB) are listed on the English language page. Not re-checked automatically. Confirm this on the university’s page.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026University of Oxford: Mathematics (course page) · University of Oxford: English language and visa requirements
Admissions tests
  • TMUA (Test of Mathematics for University Admission) — required for all applicants; test dates 12–16 October 2026

The MAT has been replaced by the TMUA. (The Our Offer page still mentions the Mathematics Admissions Test in its AP Calculus BC paragraph — older wording.)

Verified19 Oct 2026Oxford Mathematical Institute: TMUA
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Mathematics
  • Preferred: Further Mathematics (highly recommended and expected where available; offers without it are exceptional)

Further Mathematics is highly recommended and expected where available, but not required: candidates who have chosen not to take it may apply and may in exceptional circumstances receive an offer.

Verified19 Oct 2026Oxford Mathematical Institute: Our Offer

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement:
    • four APs at grade 5 including AP Calculus BC
    • or three APs at grade 5 including AP Calculus BC plus the SAT/ACT scores above
  • AP Calculus AB and BC count as one subject
